intro: Waxing every three weeks, ingrown hairs, razor bumps and dark, bumpy underarms are the reasons most patients ask about laser hair removal. The laser delivers a pulse of light that is absorbed by the pigment in the hair, heating and disabling the follicle while the surface of the skin is protected.

For Indian skin, which is mostly Fitzpatrick type IV to V, the choice of laser and settings matters. Skin with more melanin absorbs more of the laser energy, so an unsuitable machine or the wrong settings can cause burns or dark patches. At Skin Essence in Kalyani Nagar, the settings are chosen by Dr. Daksha Patel, an MD dermatologist, for your skin tone, hair thickness and the area being treated.

It is more accurate to call this hair reduction than hair removal. A full course typically reduces growth substantially, and the hair that regrows is finer and lighter. Hormonal areas, such as the chin in women with PCOS, usually need maintenance sessions. We will tell you honestly what to expect for your hair type before you commit to a package.

howItWorks.title: Consultation and test patch
howItWorks.description: We assess your skin type, hair colour and thickness, rule out conditions that need treating first, and do a test patch if your skin is sensitive or tanned.

howItWorks.title: Preparation
howItWorks.description: Shave the area 24 hours before. Avoid waxing, threading or plucking for 4 weeks and avoid tanning for 2 weeks, since the laser needs the hair root in place and the skin at its natural tone.

howItWorks.title: The session
howItWorks.description: Gel is applied and the laser handpiece is moved over the area. Each pulse feels like a warm snap. Underarms take about 10 minutes; full legs up to an hour.

howItWorks.title: Between sessions
howItWorks.description: Treated hair sheds over 1 to 3 weeks. Sessions are spaced 4 to 6 weeks apart on the face and 6 to 8 weeks on the body to catch hair in its growth phase.

sessionsAndDowntime.downtime: None; mild redness for a few hours

aftercare: Mild redness or small bumps around the follicles for a few hours are normal. A cold compress or the cream we provide settles them.
Apply sunscreen daily on exposed areas and avoid direct sun, saunas and hot yoga for 48 hours.
Do not wax, thread or pluck between sessions. Shaving is fine.
Skip scrubs, retinoids and perfumed products on the treated area for 3 days.

faqs.q: Is laser hair removal safe for dark or Indian skin?
faqs.a: Yes, when the right laser and settings are used. Diode and Nd:YAG lasers are suitable for darker skin. Burns or pigmentation usually come from wrong settings, tanned skin or untrained operators, which is why sessions here are dermatologist-supervised.

faqs.q: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.a: Most areas need 6 to 8 sessions for a substantial reduction. Coarse, dark hair responds fastest. Fine or hormonal hair, and areas like the chin in PCOS, may need more sessions and yearly maintenance.

faqs.q: How long do the results last?
faqs.a: Laser gives long-term hair reduction. After a full course, most patients have far less hair and the regrowth is finer. Some fine regrowth over time is normal, and hormonal areas may need an occasional touch-up session to stay smooth.
Most patients describe a warm snap, like a rubber band, made tolerable by cooling. Sensitive areas such as the upper lip and bikini line sting more; numbing cream can be applied if needed.

faqs.q: What does laser hair removal cost in Pune?
faqs.a: Pricing depends on the area and the number of sessions. Small areas such as the upper lip cost less per session than full arms or legs, and a package for the full course lowers the per-session cost. Exact pricing is confirmed at your consultation.
